tool.name: Uniqprimer

param.name: include
param.label: FASTA file to include
param.help: Sequences for which you want to design specific primers

param.name: exclude
param.label: FASTA file to exclude
param.help: Primers will not match these sequences

param.name: crossvalidate
param.label: Cross validate primers against exclude files for extra certainty

tool.help:
**UniqPrimer version 0.5.0**
UniqPrimer designs specific primers for sequences. The goal is to accept a number of "include" FASTA files of diagnostic target genomes (draft or complete) and "exclude" files of non-target genomes, and output a list of PCR primers that will amplify target genomes but not non-target genomes.
This tool was encapsulated in Galaxy by IRRI and the South Green Bioinformatics Platform.
Please cite appropriately.
